crossRefs.note: “ ‘You shall rise up before the gray head and honor the face of the elderly; and you shall fear your God. I am Yahweh.
Gray hair is a crown of glory. It is attained by a life of righteousness.
A king who sits on the throne of judgment scatters away all evil with his eyes.
For rulers are not a terror to the good work, but to the evil. Do you desire to have no fear of the authority? Do that…
for he is a servant of God to you for good. But if you do that which is evil, be afraid, for he doesn’t bear the sword…
Remind them to be in subjection to rulers and to authorities, to be obedient, to be ready for every good work,
Likewise, you younger ones, be subject to the elder. Yes, all of you clothe yourselves with humility, to subject…
Therefore give everyone what you owe: if you owe taxes, pay taxes; if customs, then customs; if respect, then respect…
Honor all men. Love the brotherhood. Fear God. Honor the king.

translations.web: The young men saw me and hid themselves. The aged rose up and stood.
translations.bsb: the young men saw me and withdrew, and the old men rose to their feet.
translations.kjv: The young men saw me, and hid themselves: and the aged arose, and stood up.
translations.asv: The young men saw me and hid themselves, And the aged rose up and stood;
